annotations.label: T cells (naive/memory and CD4/CD8 split unresolved)
annotations.notes: Computed: CD3D 88%, CD3E 77%, LDHB 92% detected. IL7R 66%, CCR7 36%, CD8A 12%. I dropped the 'CD4-like predominant' claim because CD4 detection is low (about 7–15% in related runs). Support: abstracts name CD3D/CD3E as T-cell genes, not LDHB. 830/852 baseline T cells recovered in downsample.

annotations.label: Monocytes (CD14+ and FCGR3A+ subsets merged)
annotations.notes: Computed: LYZ 99%, S100A9 96%, S100A8 85%; CD14 53%, FCGR3A 34%. Baseline FCGR3A+ cells (165) are merged here, so that split is resolution-sensitive. It appears at 0.6, 1.0, 1.5 and downsample. Support: the two abstracts link S100A8/S100A9 to classical monocytes. They do not support LYZ, FCN1 or LST1.

annotations.label: Cytotoxic lymphocytes (NK cells and CD8+ T cells, mixed)
annotations.notes: Computed: NKG7 99.8%, GZMA 87%, PRF1 69%, GNLY 56%; CD3D 60%, CD8A 36%, KLRF1 12%, NCAM1 2%. NK plus CD8 T mixture is an inference. The split is not resolved at 0.3 (it needs resolution of at least 1.0). Support: abstracts back NKG7/GNLY/PRF1 as cytotoxic genes, not an NK-versus-T split. Label kept broad.

annotations.label: B cells
annotations.notes: Computed: CD79A 94%, CD79B 92%, MS4A1 86%, plus HLA class II genes, TCL1A and FCER2. All 346 baseline B cells fall here (235/235 in downsample). Support: PMID 38770541 names CD79A and MS4A1 as B-cell markers, but in a CLL patient, so scope is limited. A naive-like subset is untested inference.

annotations.label: Dendritic cell-like (CD1C+ cDC-like; pDC admixture and doublets not excluded)
annotations.notes: Computed: FCER1A 83%, CLEC10A 69%, CD1C 50%, SERPINF1 44%; CLEC4C 17%. Median counts are 5297 versus about 2300 elsewhere. CD3D 17%, CD79A 17%, NKG7 33%, with only CD79A above monocytes. Per-cell co-detection was not computed. Support: 38582791 is tumor FCER1A+CD1C+ DCs; 35101945 is iPSC-derived cDC2 and does not mention FCER1A.
